timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Our AI model is smart. What's to attack?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leaks. AI has a whole new attack surface.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What are the MCSB AI controls?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: AI-1 through AI-7. Approved models, content filtering, meta-prompts, and more.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Multi-layered. Inputs, processing, and outputs. One filter layer is never enough.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Instructions that guide model behavior against manipulation. AI-3.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Yes, AI-4. Scope agent functions tightly. And keep humans in the loop for critical actions.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: AI-6. Watch inference, API calls, and plugin interactions for anomalies.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: How do we test all this?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Continuous red teaming, AI-7. PyRIT automates the adversarial prompts.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: MITRE ATLAS and OWASP Top 10 for LLM apps.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So AI security is a discipline, not a checkbox.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Exactly. And it never stops — the models keep learning new tricks.
